title: Halos root
description: The policy repo root document (halos.yaml). The simple-mode keys (tools, provider, models, gateway, telemetry, team, safety, rollout) expand into the Gateway, the default Profile and the Rings; see `halo explain`.

identity.description: The org's OIDC provider (any compliant IdP: Okta, Entra ID, Google, Keycloak, Ping, Auth0...). Used by the portal, halo-proxy / halo-kong and enrollment.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer URL; discovery is fetched from <issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration.

clientID.description: OAuth client id used by the portal.

audience.description: Audience expected in gateway bearer tokens; defaults to clientID.

userClaim.description: JWT claim holding the user id (default "email").

groupsClaim.description: JWT claim holding the user's groups (default "groups").

adminGroups.description: Groups holding halo-server's admin role. Same as roles.admin; kept for existing policy repos.

roles.description: halo-server roles (ADR-0015): IdP groups per role. A user holds every role any of their groups maps to.

viewer.description: Read fleet, releases, rollouts, experiments, toggles and policy.

operator.description: Viewer plus kill switch and experiment status (pause, resume, conclude).

approver.description: Viewer plus approving and denying access requests.

auditor.description: Read and export the audit log; nothing else.

admin.description: Everything, including devices, sessions and toggle proposals. Same as adminGroups.

groupsOverage.description: Console login when the ID token says the user's groups did not fit (Entra ID groups overage: _claim_names / hasgroups): deny (default) refuses the login with a clear error; graph reads them from Microsoft Graph /me/getMemberObjects with the login's access token (ADR-0036).

requireAcr.description: Console login only: the ID token's acr must be one of these (sent as acr_values), e.g. Okta urn:okta:loa:2fa:any.

requireAmr.description: Console login only: the ID token's amr must contain at least one of these, e.g. [mfa].

enabled.description: Turn the portal's self-service features on.

requestable.description: Kinds of access developers may request (approval opens a policy PR).

catalog.description: MCP servers developers may request that aren't in their profile yet.

enrollmentTTLSeconds.description: Lifetime of one-time laptop bootstrap tokens (default 900).

delegation.description: What units (ADR-0018) may add on top of the baseline; anything else a unit adds is a loosening that validate rejects. MCP servers a unit adds must be exact selfService.catalog entries.

allowHooks.description: Let units add hooks.items (shell commands every member's harness runs). Default false.

envKeys.description: Env names units may add. Provider, cloud, base-URL, proxy, telemetry, CA-trust and runtime-injection names (*_BASE_URL, *_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_*, OPENAI_*, GEMINI_*, CLAUDE_CODE_*, AWS_*, GOOGLE_*, CLOUD_ML_REGION, HTTP(S)_PROXY, ALL_PROXY, NO_PROXY, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_*, SSL_CERT_FILE, SSL_CERT_DIR, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE, CURL_CA_BUNDLE, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, PATH, BASH_ENV, ENV, GIT_SSH_COMMAND, GIT_CONFIG_*, GIT_EXEC_PATH, npm_config_*, JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS, _JAVA_OPTIONS, PERL5OPT, RUBYOPT, NODE_*, LD_*, DYLD_*, PYTHON*, every GIT_* but commit identity, CC, CXX, CGO_*, GO module sources (GOPROXY, GOSUMDB, GONOSUMDB, GOPRIVATE, ...), PIP_*, UV_*, YARN_*, BUNDLE_*, GEM_*, build tool options and DOCKER_HOST; any case) are refused even here.

workloads.description: Workload identity federation for headless CI / cloud agents (ADR-0023): halo-server exchanges a token from a trusted OIDC issuer for a short-lived gateway credential when a rule matches its claims.

audience.description: aud the CI token must carry (e.g. halos); an issuer may override it.

issuers.description: Trusted OIDC issuers, e.g. GitHub Actions https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com, GitLab https://gitlab.com, Buildkite https://agent.buildkite.com, CircleCI https://oidc.circleci.com/org/<org-id>, Google https://accounts.google.com.

url.description: Exact iss claim; discovery is <url>/.well-known/openid-configuration. https (http only for loopback).

audience.description: Overrides workloads.audience for this issuer (CircleCI's default aud is the organization id).

tenantClaim.description: The claim naming the tenant (org, group, account) a token was minted for; every rule of this issuer must match it exactly. Required for issuers Halos does not know; for GitHub, GitLab.com, Buildkite, CircleCI, Google and Entra ID it may only pick one of their tenant claims.

rules.description: Tried in order; the first rule of the token's issuer whose every match entry holds mints the credential.

match.description: Claim name -> exact value or glob (* never crosses /). One of the issuer's tenant claims must be matched exactly, or as literal/* (GitHub: repository_owner_id, repository_owner, repository or repository_id; GitLab.com: namespace_id, namespace_path, project_id or project_path; Buildkite: organization_id or organization_slug; CircleCI: oidc.circleci.com/org-id; Google: email or sub; Entra ID: tid; other issuers: their tenantClaim).

subject.description: Workload subject id; {claim} expands to that claim's value, e.g. workload:gh:{repository}.

groups.description: Groups the workload gets (ring membership, budgets) like a human's IdP groups.

experiments.description: Enroll workloads in experiments and shadows like humans (default false: control routing).

tools.description: Simple mode: harnesses to enable, each pinned to an exact CLI version: a bare version, or {version, model} where model is a models alias the tool starts on instead of default.

model.description: A models alias this tool starts on instead of default.

provider.description: Simple mode: where models run. A name, or a mapping with its settings.

region.description: AWS region (bedrock, default us-east-1) or Vertex region (default global).

url.description: Override the provider's base URL (e.g. an internal orchestrator).

models.description: Simple mode: model alias -> provider model id, or a list of ids in failover order. An id may be prefixed <provider>/ (required with provider multi). The default alias is required.

gateway.description: Simple mode: the gateway base URL clients are pointed at.

gatewayEngine.description: Simple mode: what serves gateway: halo-proxy (default), kong, or external (your own API gateway; clients are sent provider model ids).

telemetry.description: Simple mode: OTLP/HTTP endpoint. Telemetry is always on.

team.description: Simple mode: ring0 members, IdP groups or user ids (containing @). Default: identity.adminGroups, else <org>-ai-platform.

safety.description: Simple mode: safety preset (default standard). No preset bypasses permissions.

rollout.description: Simple mode: rollout preset (rings and step template; default standard).

governance.description: Change governance (ADR-0030): freeze windows that hold rollout advances and promotions (never rollbacks or the kill switch), and approver quorums with separation of duties. halo-server adds an incident freeze (`halo freeze on|off`).

freezes.description: Change-freeze windows: one-off (start, end) or weekly, in a time zone.

name.description: Unique window name (not `incident`, halo-server's incident freeze).

reason.description: Shown to whoever the freeze stops.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York (default UTC). Times are wall-clock there: DST moves the instant, not the time.

start.description: One-off start: 2026-12-18T18:00, 2026-12-18 (midnight) or RFC 3339 with an offset.

end.description: One-off end (exclusive), same formats as start.

weekly.description: Recurs every week from `from` to `to`; a `to` at or before `from` ends the next week.

approvals.description: Approver quorums. Every rule whose scope covers a change (access request, rollout step) must be met; the requester never counts.

groups.description: IdP or SCIM groups an approver must hold one of.

distinctGroups.description: Each counted approval must come from a different group.

ticket.description: Regular expression (matched whole) a change ticket reference must match, e.g. CHG[0-9]{7}. Recorded in the audit log and PR body.

vendorAdmin.description: Vendor admin sync (ADR-0025): drive the vendors' cloud admin consoles from one ring's profile with `halo admin plan|apply|export`. A vendor is managed when its key is present. Credentials never live here.

ring.description: Ring whose profile the consoles get; console settings are org-wide (default: the last ring, GA).

claude.description: Claude for Teams/Enterprise server-managed settings (no API: exported for the claude.ai console).

codex.description: ChatGPT workspace Agent security requirements (no documented API: exported as requirements.toml).

gemini.description: Gemini Code Assist settings through the Gemini for Google Cloud API (read and write). project is required.

copilot.description: GitHub Copilot org content exclusion (read and write) and CLI policy (read). org is required.

cursor.description: Cursor team model allowlist (exported for the dashboard).

cloudAgents.description: Cloud agent governance (ADR-0034): background coding agents on vendor or CI infrastructure (Claude Code GitHub Action and cloud sessions, Codex cloud, Copilot cloud agent, Cursor cloud agents, Gemini CLI GitHub Action). A vendor is governed when its key is present. Credentials never live here.

identities.description: Vendor logins mapped to Halos users, so a cloud task resolves to its human's ring, experiments and budgets.

github.description: GitHub login (Claude and Gemini actions, Copilot cloud agent).

server.description: halo-server base URL rendered workflows exchange their OIDC token at (identity: workload).

haloVersion.description: halo release tag rendered workflows install for the exchange (identity: workload).

claude.description: Claude Code GitHub Action (rendered workflow) and Claude Code cloud sessions (console).

codex.description: Codex cloud tasks (console; no public task API).

copilot.description: Copilot cloud agent (rendered copilot-setup-steps.yml; firewall read per repository).

cursor.description: Cursor cloud agents (Cloud Agents API: list, cancel, archive).

agents.description: Agent identity and delegation (ADR-0024): which agents may act for a principal (RFC 8693 act chain), how deep and for how long, what delegated agents may not do, and the allowlist of remote A2A agents.

maxTTLSeconds.description: Delegated credential lifetime cap (default 900). Never longer than the parent's remaining lifetime.

experiments.description: Enroll delegated callers in experiments with their root (default false: control routing, no shadow).

allowedModels.description: Gateway model aliases any delegated agent may call; empty = every alias the root may.

deniedTools.description: Tools a delegated agent's model call may not declare: function names (case-insensitive) and hosted tool identifiers such as web_search, code_execution or mcp:<server> (prefix match ignoring case and underscores). With any set, an agent call whose tools the gateway cannot read is refused.

actors.description: Agents that may act. Any other actor_id is refused.

harnesses.description: Harnesses it may run in (claude-code, codex, gemini-cli, copilot-cli, cursor-agent, opencode); empty = any.

groups.description: The root must hold one of these groups; empty = any root.

remote.description: Allowlisted remote A2A agents. Answered by POST /api/v1/agents/egress and pinned into ring releases.

digest.description: sha256 of the card's RFC 8785 canonical JSON, as `halo agents verify` prints it.

publicKey.description: PEM public key (Ed25519, ECDSA P-256/P-384, RSA >= 2048) the card's JWS signature must verify with.

jwksURL.description: https JWKS holding the card signing key. A jku in the card is never followed.

skills.description: Skill ids that may be invoked; empty = any.

rings.description: Rings whose members may call it.

units.description: Units (and units below them) whose members may call it.

supplyChain.description: Agent supply chain (ADR-0028): the skills, plugins, hooks, slash commands and agent definitions releases deliver, each pinned by content digest, statically scanned at `halo validate` and `halo release build`, optionally signature-checked, and listed in the release AI-BOM.

scan.description: Static scan mode: warn (default) reports findings as warnings, enforce makes them errors (as does `--strict`), off skips the scan.

requireSignatures.description: Refuse a git or oci artifact unless it is signed by a trusted identity.

artifacts.description: Extension artifacts, referenced by name from a profile's extensions.artifacts.

trustedIdentities.description: Keys artifact signatures may be made with.

allowFindings.description: Scan findings suppressed by content digest; changed content is scanned afresh. An entry that suppresses nothing warns.

mcp.description: Approved MCP server registry (ADR-0029). Releases render each ring's and unit's servers into every harness's native MCP settings; halod reports other or version-drifted servers in user configs.

mode.description: allowlist (default): the registry is each harness's managed MCP allowlist and profiles, units and toggles may name only registry servers. warn: render the registry, block nothing else, report drift.

org.description: Tenant: the GitHub organization login (copilot, required), or the Claude organization / ChatGPT workspace / Cursor team id recorded in exports.

project.description: Google Cloud project holding the Gemini Code Assist settings (gemini only, required).

location.description: Location of the Gemini settings resources (gemini only; default global).

releaseChannel.description: Gemini Code Assist release channel (gemini only); unset leaves it unmanaged.

changeScope.description: What a window or rule covers: changes to any listed ring, or reaching any listed unit's members (a ring change reaches every unit). Empty = org-wide.

artifact.description: One extension artifact. Set exactly one source: path, git or oci.

kind.description: skill: a directory holding SKILL.md; plugin: a plugin directory; hook: scripts a hooks.items command runs; command: one Markdown slash command; agent: one Markdown subagent definition.

path.description: File or directory in the policy repo, relative to its root.

git.description: A git repository pinned to a full commit id (branches and tags are refused).

path.description: Path within the repository (default its root).

oci.description: Digest-pinned OCI reference host/repo@sha256:<hex>; each layer is one file named by its org.opencontainers.image.title annotation (`oras push`).

digest.description: Artifact digest (`halo artifact digest <path>`): sha256 of the sorted `sha256sum` listing of its files. Required for git and oci; checked for path when set.

file.description: Signature file in the policy repo: base64 ed25519 (`halo artifact sign`) or cosign sign-blob output.

trustedIdentity.description: A signing identity. Set exactly one of publicKey and cosignKey.

publicKey.description: ed25519 public key PEM in the policy repo (`halo keys generate`).

cosignKey.description: cosign public key reference: a file in the policy repo, an absolute path, or a KMS URI.

digest.description: The artifact digest (any of its files) or one file's sha256 (that file only).

mcpRegistryServer.description: One approved MCP server: exactly one transport (url, package, or command with a binary package), pinned.

id.description: Server name rendered into every harness (no '_' or '.': harnesses join it into tool names).

registryName.description: Official MCP Registry server.json name it was imported from.

version.description: server.json version it was imported at.

url.description: Remote (streamable HTTP) server URL; also the audience of Halos-minted tokens.

command.description: stdio command line; only with a binary package (the executable first).

identifier.description: Package name (npm, pypi) or image reference without tag or digest (oci).

version.description: Exact version (npm, pypi): no range, tag or latest.

sha256.description: Image digest (oci) or executable digest (binary); required for both.

args.description: Appended to the derived command line.

headers.description: HTTP headers; secrets as ${VAR} references resolved on the client.

tools.description: Narrows the server's tools (ADR-0029). deny wins over allow; empty allow = every tool.

allow.description: Only these tools (where the harness supports an allowlist; else a manifest warning).

auth.description: How clients authorize to a remote server (ADR-0029).

mode.description: none (default) | oauth (the server's authorization server) | enterprise (Enterprise-Managed Authorization: an ID-JAG from identity.issuer) | halos (halo-server mints audience-bound tokens).

clientIDMetadataURL.description: https URL of an org-hosted Client ID Metadata Document (oauth); the URL is the client id.

units.description: Units (and units below them) whose members get it. Rings and units both empty = approved only (a toggle may deliver it).

enabled.description: false: nothing that runs the agent is rendered and every observed task is a violation.

repos.description: Repositories the agent may work in: owner/repo or owner/* (default every repository).

models.description: Vendor model ids the agent may use; the first is rendered as the default where the vendor takes one.

perUser.description: Running tasks per Halos user (0 = no cap).

perGroup.description: Running tasks per listed group (0 = no cap).

groups.description: Groups that each get a perGroup counter (required with perGroup).

items.description: One budget (ADR-0017 fields) over vendor-reported task usage. action is warn only: cloud usage is reported after the fact, so onOverLimit decides whether to pause.

scope.description: Counter key: user (per verified subject), group (per listed group), ring (per ring) or org (one shared counter).

groups.description: Scope group: the groups that each get a counter (required). Other scopes: count only callers in one of these groups.

rings.description: Count only callers routed to these rings (default every ring).

window.description: day, week (from Monday) or month: calendar windows in UTC. rolling: the last period.

period.description: Rolling window length as a Go duration between 1h and 2160h, e.g. 24h. Rolling only.

limitUSD.description: Spend cap in USD for the window, priced from pricing.

limitTokens.description: Token cap for the window (input + output + cache reads and writes).

action.description: warn only (default); over-limit handling is onOverLimit.

alertAt.description: Soft thresholds as fractions of the limit (default [0.8]): a header and a metric when crossed.

budgets.description: Caps on vendor-reported task usage (ADR-0017 budget fields).

network.description: Sandbox egress, where the vendor has a setting.

mode.description: none: no egress; allowlist: only allow (plus the vendor's dependency list when recommended); full: any host (warned).

allow.description: Extra domains; a leading *. matches subdomains.

recommended.description: Keep the vendor's own dependency allowlist (allowlist only).

identity.description: workload: rendered workflows call the model through the Halos gateway with a short-lived workload credential (ADR-0023) instead of a repository secret (claude, gemini).

onOverLimit.description: alert (default) reports; pause also pauses the agent where the vendor API can, reversibly, and never resumes it.

version.description: Agent CLI version pin where the vendor takes one (gemini).

timeoutMinutes.description: Job timeout of rendered workflows (copilot at most 59).
